name: PAX Gold
oneLiner: PAXG is Paxos's centralized gold token redeemable 1:1 for fine troy ounces of LBMA Good Delivery bars held in Brink's London vaults under OCC trust supervision.
collateral: LBMA Good Delivery physical gold bars allocated in Brink's London vaults; each token represents one fine troy ounce; insured against theft and loss; bankruptcy-remote custody under Paxos Trust Company
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption through Paxos Trust Company for physical gold bars or cash equivalent; monthly independent attestation by KPMG LLP under AICPA standards confirms full backing

mintAuthority.summary: PAXG supply is controlled by Paxos-operated infrastructure. The token (AdminUpgradeabilityProxy) delegates to a SupplyControl proxy with multiple SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE holders; the SupplyControl defaultAdmin and the token defaultAdmin/owner are the same Paxos-operated EOA.

controls.label: PAXG SupplyControl proxy (multi-controller mint surface)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, supplyControl() on the PAXG proxy returned 0xbe62db8ed4838e10e1318593ac9e3eb9ccfb2dc7. This SupplyControl proxy (ERC1967Proxy over SupplyControl implementation 0xbb9f637f) holds multiple SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE EOAs: 0xf845a0a0, 0x2fb074fa, plus one sub-proxy 0xd09ede55. Previously recorded supplyController EOA 0x2fb074FA is now one of three controllers within the SupplyControl proxy.

controls.label: PAXG token defaultAdmin and SupplyControl defaultAdmin (Paxos EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, defaultAdmin() and owner() on the PAXG proxy both returned 0x3Af3e85f4f97De7AD0f000B724Fb77fE5ffc024B; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). The same address is defaultAdmin of the SupplyControl proxy.

controls.label: PAXG proxy admin (upgrade authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, proxy admin slot (0x10d6a54a...) on PAXG returned 0xc94bcf6e1d8b3558e3b62e743630d50497e3851c; eth_getCode returned no bytecode (EOA). The PAXG token is an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096: PAXG is an AdminUpgradeabilityProxy (impl 0x7da4c5d9, proxy admin EOA 0xc94bcf6e). supplyControl() returned SupplyControl proxy 0xbe62db8e with 3 SUPPLY_CONTROLLER_ROLE holders including the old EOA 0x2fb074fa. defaultAdmin/owner = Paxos EOA 0x3af3e85f. Data corrected from prior record which listed supplyController as a single EOA.
